For example, the Hymn of Seasons would transform a forested area in winter to that of summer, therefore causing vegetation to sprout its mature foliage, any hibernating animals to awaken, flowers to bloom, and the sun to appear higher in the sky (if a planetary axial tilt exists in the setting). This seasonal change lasts for 1 hour per Practitioner Title, after which the area reverts back to its previous state over the next 1 hour (flowers die, animals go back to sleep, etc.).

Spirit.name: Spirit
Spirit.description: Allows the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist`s deity to fall into a meditative state and communicate with any bodiless spirits within a radius of 50` per Practitioner Title. Knowledge of the spirits` true names is not required, since this hymn does not allow for the calling of specific spirits. The effected listeners remain in this state, able to communicate with spirits, for 1 minute per Practitioner Title.

Twilight.name: Twilight
Twilight.description: Creates a sphere with a radius of 10` per Practitioner Title, up to 2` per Practitioner Title away from the hymnist, where both light and darkness are suppressed, resulting in a shadowy, gray area devoid of bright light or deep darkness. Neither the living nor the dead receive any bonuses or penalties within the affected area. The sphere is centered on a fixed location when created and cannot be moved, and it lasts for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title. The hymns of Noontide and Midnight will override the Hymn of Twilight if the latter hymnist makes Hymn Lore roll by more than the previous hymnist.

Volcanism.name: Volcanism
Volcanism.description: Causes one active volcano within sight to suddenly erupt, spitting hot gases, smoke, and lava into the air and into the vicinity of the volcano. See Volcanic Eruptions in Legends of the Unknown. This will only occur if the hymnist`s deity wishes for the volcano to erupt (at the GM`s discretion). The lethality and duration of the eruption are determined by conditions of the existing volcano.

Winds.name: Winds
Winds.description: Creates a steady gust of wind moving 5 miles per hour per Practitioner Title which blows throughout an area with a 10` radius per Practitioner Title from the hymnist, causing objects to be tossed about. When this wind is felt upon bare skin and breathed in deeply, the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist`s deity are granted the skills Balance, Listen, Meditate, and Smell at 10% per Practitioner Title, lasting for as long as the listener remains within the wind. The wind lasts for 5 minutes per Practitioner Title. Furthermore, all affected listeners have a 1% chance per Practitioner Title of being soothed and cured of insanity, as per the skills, as soon as they feel the wind.

Witchcraft.name: Witchcraft
Witchcraft.description: Grants the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist`s deity a +5% bonus per Practitioner Titles to the skills Candle Lore, Curse, Detect Curse, Empathy Magic, Herb Lore, Potion Lore, Ritual Lore, Speak to Dead, and Sympathy Magic for 1 hour per Practitioner title.

Abomination.name: Abomination
Abomination.description: Creates either 3 lesser undead or 1 greater undead per 2 Practitioner Titles from the corpses of those who, while living, followed the hymnist`s deity, by infusing those corpses the hymnist touches with negative life force. The type of undead is based upon the corpse and the conditions of its death (see Epitaph of the Fallen).

Animosity.name: Animosity
Animosity.description: Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or suddenly take hostile action against each other, including derogatory words and offensive attacks. This hymn does not affect thoughts or emotions but rather releases control over each listener`s innermost evil, immoral desires, and hidden, buried dislikes of those around them. Furthermore, those who fall under this hymn`s affect will also attempt to convince those who have not yet taken hostile action to do so. For every 10 seconds the hymn continues, all listeners who have not yet succumbed to animosity must make a new Control Resistance with a cumulative 5% penalty. This hymn cannot last more than 10 minutes total, and once the hymn is over, the temporary aggression instantly and abruptly ends.

Betrayal.name: Betrayal
Betrayal.description: Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or betray a particular cause or being, resulting in a -5% per Practitioner Title to Will Force saves when attempting to perform anything which furthers that cause or is requested by that being, and will avoid defending the cause or being at all costs. Furthermore, all affected listeners have -20% to morale whenever within the vicinity of the being or acting for the good of that being or cause. Effects last 1 day per practitioner title.

Blasphemy.name: Blasphemy
Blasphemy.description: Bestows a curse upon all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity, resulting in a penalty of -1 to hit and -5% to all resistance rolls per 3 Practitioner Titles, lasting 1 hour. This curse may be lifted with the skill Remove Curse.

Blindness.name: Blindness
Blindness.description: Strikes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity blind, unless a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made, for 10d6 seconds. Blind beings are -8 to hit with melee weapons, -16 to hit with missile weapons, -4 to damage, -20% to all combat skills, and have no defensive modifier. Furthermore, these listeners are immune to gaze attacks (such as Fear, Brilliance, Entrancement, Illusion of Sight, and those which transform).

Call Infernal.name: Call Infernal
Call Infernal.description: Summons or dismisses an Evil-aligned supernatural servant by name (the hymnist must know the true name of the servant to summon or dismiss), either of which cannot be resisted by the servant. When summoning, control is automatically granted to the hymnist if the deity wishes it, unless the supernatural servant is immune to control. When dismissing, the servant must remain within earshot of the hymnist during the entire 10 minutes of the hymn.

Concealment.name: Concealment
Concealment.description: Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity to temporarily be unable to sense a particular being or object, either through sight, sound, touch, smell, hearing, or magical and divine magical means, for 1 minute per Practitioner Title. This is only an illusion, and an Illusion Resistance negates the effect. This does not physically remove or displace the target, and the target can still be damaged or affected by outside forces. If the being or object moves more than a couple of inches, the effect is immediately broken.

Condemnation.name: Condemnation
Condemnation.description: Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or grow hostile toward all personal debts or grudges. This creates desires for revenge, resulting in a -20% per Practitioner Title to Will Force rolls to immediately attempt to collect debts and or settle old scores through hostile action. Effects last 1 day per Practitioner title.

Contamination.name: Contamination
Contamination.description: Introduces a named disease or poison to all food and water within 5` per Practitioner Title. The poison can be of a type no greater than 2 levels per Practitioner Title but takes effect immediately (Potency J) upon contact or ingestion, etc. Diseases selected cannot be magical or divine in nature. Normal Poison and Disease Resistances apply.

Covetousness.name: Covetousness
Covetousness.description: Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or covet that which belongs to others, whether valuable or not, resulting in the need to make a Will Force save or attempt to steal 1 item which does not belong to them every 2 minutes for the following hour.

Damnation.name: Damnation
Damnation.description: Causes the hymnist`s deity to intervene in an otherwise safe situation and divinely, miraculously inflict a highly dangerous and potentially fatal event in a particular place no larger than 1 mile per Practitioner Title or on a group of beings consisting of no more than 10 individuals per Practitioner Title, in whichever way that deity chooses. The means of damnation is completely at the GM`s discretion. However, if the GM decides that the hymnist`s enemies do not warrant damnation, or that performing this act does not fit into the deity`s predestined plan, nothing happens. This hymn may only be sung once per month, and any further attempts may invoke the anger and wrath of that particular deity, resulting in divine denial.

Darkness.name: Darkness
Darkness.description: Causes a divine magical pure black sphere of darkness, with a radius of 1` per Practitioner Title, to appear no further than 5` away per Will Force point. The sphere can be centered on a moveable object or being, or can be fixed in one place. All light, magical or otherwise, is non-visible while the globe is in effect. Lasts 5 minutes per Will Force of the hymnist. Only one globe per Practitioner Title may be active. Fire will still be lit within the magical sphere and will still be hot, just not visible. All forms of vision that operate within the spectrum of light are nonfunctional within the sphere (such as all forms of Night Vision, Ultravision and Infravision). The hymnist`s vision is not affected by the darkness. Beings and magic items targeted get a Piety save to avoid the effects.

Deafness.name: Deafness
Deafness.description: Strikes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity deaf, unless a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made, for 10d6 seconds. Deafened beings are -1 to initiative, +50% to be surprised, and +1 to be struck during combat.

Deception.name: Deception
Deception.description: Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or speak only lies and be completely unable to tell the truth in any way for 1d4 minutes. The affected beings can choose to remain silent.

Defilement.name: Defilement
Defilement.description: Causes 1 listener per Practitioner Title who follows a Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance of become morally corrupt for the duration, resulting in cravings for power, money, destruction, and other evil desires. A normally calm and peaceful being would become violent if provoked or kept from fulfilling her desires. 30 minutes per Practitioner Title after the hymn ends, each affected listener reverts back to the previous alignment and loses all memory of events that transpired while corrupted. This hymn has no effect on followers of Neutral-Good deities.

Degeneration.name: Degeneration
Degeneration.description: Wounds any one existing body area to exactly -1 Endurance, affecting 1 listener per Practitioner Title who does not follow the hymnist`s deity. Furthermore, up to 1 limb per 4 Practitioner Titles is instantaneously removed at the cost of 1 Will Force per limb, paid by the hymnist. Vital areas cannot be removed in this way. Multiple sub-areas removed (such as several fingers on the same hand) count as one limb.

Depravation.name: Depravation
Depravation.description: Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or gain a sudden need for food and water. Those affected must eat a full meal once per hour or begin starving (subtracting 1d4+1 Base Endurance per hour) and drink 8 oz. of liquid every hour or begin dying of dehydration (subtracting 1d6+1 Base Endurance per hour). This depravation lasts for 1 full day per Practitioner Title. If Base Endurance is reduced to 0 or below, the being must make a Vitality save at -5% per point under 0 or fall unconscious and collapse. Anyone whose Base Endurance drops to 0 minus their Vitality rating dies immediately.

Enmity.name: Enmity
Enmity.description: Causes all listeners who follow a Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel intense hostility and animosity toward each other, causing them to attack the nearest living being who follows a Good-aligned deity until either dead or not moving. Thereafter, a new resistance is allowed, or the listener must attack the next nearest target. This hymn will continue to affect listeners for as long as the hymnist is singing. Once the hymn ends, affected listeners immediately lose this feeling of enmity but retain all memory of the deeds they committed while under the hymn`s influence.

Estrangement.name: Estrangement
Estrangement.description: Causes all listeners who follow one particular deity (either that of the hymnist or another) to lose all sense of bonding with each other and instead be filled with a nervous, uneasy estrangement, losing a total of 2% per Practitioner Title when collectively attempting to Commune with their deity. The affected listeners are also -30% to morale and -5% per 2 Practitioner Titles to all skills performed on each other (such as Cure Poison, Bless, etc.). In cases where the affected listeners of a single religion are bonded in a way other than through a deity, this hymn removes all means of mental and spiritual contact with each other, even overriding magical effects such as Mindlink and Emotion Sense. These effects last for 1 hour per Practitioner Title.

Exoneration.name: Exoneration
Exoneration.description: Causes all non-magical and non-divine locks and bindings (including rope, cuffs, etc.) to open within 1` per Practitioner Title of the hymnist and all listeners who follow the hymnist`s deity who are currently being held or imprisoned justly for committing a crime or evil deed.

Frailty.name: Frailty
Frailty.description: Lowers the Strength rating by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (cannot be lowered below 5) of all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity if they fail a Magic Resistance. Strength points lost in this manner return at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Greed.name: Greed
Greed.description: Causes all listeners to be filled with an overwhelming sense of greed unless a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made, resulting in a desire to steal, ask for, keep, or otherwise obtain items of any value at all. This feeling ends after 1 hour.

Hatred.name: Hatred
Hatred.description: Causes the hymnist (if willing) and all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or hate the hymn`s subject (being, location, object, or idea) with all their hearts. Affected listeners must go berserk whenever in the presence of the subject and will go to any length to utterly destroy that subject. These feelings of hatred fade after 1 hour.

Idiocy.name: Idiocy
Idiocy.description: Lowers the Intelligence rating by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (cannot be lowered below 5) of all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity if they fail a Magic Resistance. Intelligence points lost in this manner return at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Infirmity.name: Infirmity
Infirmity.description: Inflicts a -5% per Practitioner Title penalty to Poison and Disease Resistances for 1 hour and inflicts one particular named terminal disease to all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity, unless the target makes their normal Disease Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title. This terminal disease may be either mundane, magical, or divine magical in nature.

Indulgence.name: Indulgence
Indulgence.description: Causes 1 listener who follows the hymnist`s deity and all listeners who follow a Neutral-Good or Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance or indulge in all actions, beings, and places considered immoral or evil in any way for 1 hour. Indulging in such activities includes drinking solely to get drunk, participating in less than seemly activities, overeating, etc.

Ineptness.name: Ineptness
Ineptness.description: Lowers the Wisdom rating by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (cannot be lowered below 5) of all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity if they fail a Magic Resistance. Wisdom points lost in this manner return at a rate of 1 per 10 minutes, beginning 30 minutes after the hymn ends.

Infliction.name: Infliction
Infliction.description: Inflicts one particular mild disease to all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity, unless a Disease Resistance is made. This disease may be either mundane, magical, or divine magical in nature.

Insolence.name: Insolence
Insolence.description: Causes all listeners who follow a Neutral or Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or become rude and insolent in deed and speech for 1 hour. This would cause affected listeners to slander their friends, refuse to help someone in need, use foul language, become drunk at an inappropriate time, etc.

Instillation.name: Instillation
Instillation.description: Instills in all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity with Type VI, Potency Q Poison, which gradually inflicts 1d4 damage to overall Endurance per hour for a total of 2d4 hours, unless a Poison Resistance is made.

Insubordination.name: Insubordination
Insubordination.description: Releases all listeners who follow the hymnist`s deity from all possession and other effects of control for a temporary span of 1d4 minutes. After the duration, the listeners must make another Control Resistance or fall under the effects of their previous possession or control.

Isolation.name: Isolation
Isolation.description: Inflicts all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity with a -2% penalty per Practitioner Title to Commune Chance and a -5% penalty per Practitioner Title to the skills Divination and Omen for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title, unless a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made.

Jealousy.name: Jealousy
Jealousy.description: Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or become extremely jealous, resulting in the need for a Will Force save to avoid attempting the skill Steal each time they become aware of someone else owning a valuable item. This includes every time the listener sees someone wearing nice clothes or jewelry, living in a nice house, eating good food, etc., at the GM`s discretion. This urge lasts for 1 hour.

Malady.name: Malady
Malady.description: Inflicts a -2% per Practitioner Title penalty to Poison and Disease Resistances for 1 hour, unless a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title is made.

Malevolence.name: Malevolence
Malevolence.description: Causes 1 listener per Practitioner Title who does not follow the hymnist`s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel a sense of total selfishness and lack of concern for the welfare of others, resulting in a Will Force save at -5% per Practitioner Title to perform any action that would in any way be considered selfless or generous (at the GM`s discretion). For example, this hymn would affect the listener`s attempt at the skills Healing and Exorcism, or force someone to claim a newly found magical item or object of value whether they needed it or not. Furthermore, the listener must make a Will Force save at -5% per Practitioner Title or refuse to defend someone, either in conversation or in combat. This feeling of malevolence lasts for 1 minute per Practitioner Title.

Midnight.name: Midnight
Midnight.description: Creates a sphere of true night, even during the day, covering the area with the darkness of midnight. All beings within the sphere are affected as if it were night. All effects which are dependent upon darkness or nighttime apply, regardless of the actual time. Thus, within the sphere of the Hymn of Midnight, a Lesser Vampire, normally debilitated during daylight hours, would function as normal while inside the sphere. The sphere, which has a radius of 10` per Practitioner Title, is centered on a fixed location (up to 2` per Practitioner Title from the hymnist) when created and cannot be moved, and it lasts for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title. The hymns of Twilight and Noontide will override the Hymn of Midnight if the latter hymnist makes a Hymn Lore roll by more than the previous hymnist.

Murder.name: Murder
Murder.description: Causes up to 2 listeners per Practitioner Title to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel an intense urge to immediately attack the nearest being, with the intent and focus of murdering them. Once the target being dies, a new resistance must be made to avoid attacking the next nearest being. This urge continues for as long as the hymnist is singing and fades 2d6 seconds after the hymn ends.

Necromancy.name: Necromancy
Necromancy.description: Grants a +5% per Practitioner Title bonus to 1 listener who follows a Neutral-Evil or Evil-aligned deity to the following for 1 hour: Control Undead, Flesh Lore. Candle Lore rituals: Coexist with Undead, Death Stench, Protection from Undead, Spirit Bind (when targeted at undead). Ritual Lore rituals: Bind Form, Conceal Dead, Magnify Shadow, Positive Life Vapor. Poems: Darkness, Shadow. Songs: Decay, Death Warrior. Ballads: Deadwalk, Decomposition, Mask of Death. Runes: Binding (when only activated by undead), Corruption, Mark of Death, Natural Darkness, Night.

Perversion.name: Perversion
Perversion.description: Causes the hymnist and all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title (if unwilling) or be unable to avoid saying or doing anything that would be considered immoral or evil for 1 hour.

Possession.name: Possession
Possession.description: Causes 1 listener to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or become possessed by the hymnist for 1 hour per Practitioner Title after the hymn is complete. Once the hymn ends after 10 seconds, the hymnist is in mental contact with the target (if they remain within sight) and may take possession with 5 seconds of simple concentration (with no additional Control Resistance afforded). While in possession, the hymnist has complete control of the target, whose will is totally subverted. The hymnist`s own body will stand or sit as it was. If the hymnist`s body takes more than 10 points of damage, then a concentration roll (Intelligence save) is required to avoid having the hymnist`s mind forcibly returned to the hymnist`s body. After 1 hour per Practitioner Title, the possession target is no longer considered controlled.

Prejudice.name: Prejudice
Prejudice.description: Temporarily instills Xenophobia (fear of outsiders and beings who are different) in all listeners for 1 hour.

Pride.name: Pride
Pride.description: Causes all listeners who follow a Good-aligned deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or lose all humility and meekness and instead be filled with a false sense of pride and unseemly boastfulness, resulting in -1 Charm, -1 Piety per 2 Practitioner Titles, and the need to make a Will Force save at -5% per Practitioner Title to perform any action that would be considered humble or submissive (at the GM`s discretion). This would include thanking someone for something or allowing someone else to partake first of food, etc. These effects last for 1 hour.

Revulsion.name: Revulsion
Revulsion.description: Decreases the Appearance and Charm of all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity by 1 per 2 Practitioner Titles (not to be reduced below 5) while speaking about their own deity or performing a skill in that deity`s name, such as Bless, Convert, Exorcism, Hymn Lore, etc. This effect lasts for 10 minutes per Practitioner Title.

Sacrilege.name: Sacrilege
Sacrilege.description: Causes all listeners who do not follow the hymnist`s deity to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or perform 2d4 actions contrary to the teachings, beliefs, or standards of their own particular deity. This would include cursing in the deity`s name, stealing a divine item imbued by that deity, speaking badly of that deity, murdering, lying, refusing to perform necessary religious rites, etc.

Temptation.name: Temptation
Temptation.description: Lowers the Will Force saves of all listeners by 5% per Practitioner Title when being tempted to take any action that would be considered evil, resulting in possible alignment checks. This temptation lasts for 2 hours after the hymn ends.

Territorialism.name: Territorialism
Territorialism.description: Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or feel an overwhelming urge to protect their territory, whether it be their residence, favorite location, campsite, etc., by attacking any outsiders or visitors (animal, plant, or otherwise) and going to any means necessary to make their territory more physically appealing by repairing, decorating, etc. The listener will also attempt to make known the fact to others that the territory belongs to them, either through writing or other means. This feeling of territorialism lasts for 1 hour.

Vanity.name: Vanity
Vanity.description: Causes all listeners to make a Control Resistance at -2% per Practitioner Title or temporarily become extremely vain and obsessed over their physical appearance. Over the next hour, the affected listeners must go to any extreme to make themselves more physically attractive, no matter the cost. This may result in an increased Appearance rating and/or a decreased Charm rating, or both at the GM`s discretion.
